title: Pause and step through frames in the local H.264 video

input.provenance: Pre-existing local reference fixture; not copied into the repository. SHA-256 and ffprobe codec/dimensions/frame-rate/duration verified locally.

preconditions: Set KINOVEA_ORACLE_MP4 to the verified local video file.
Use the verified existing win64 Wine prefix and matching Kinovea executable.
No Kinovea window may already be open.

actions.description: Use Kinovea's Ctrl+O dialog to open the specified fixture from a blank disposable workspace.
Capture the initial frame after opening; the dialog open path leaves this clip paused in this environment.
Request next frame with Kinovea's default Right shortcut.
Capture after the second next-frame request.
Request the previous frame with Kinovea's default Left shortcut.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Open the specified H.264 reference clip and show its visible metadata.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Review title/dimensions/frame-rate in the app window and compare fixture provenance.

expectedOutcomes.observation: Two Right requests change displayed content and one Left returns the capture to the first forward-step image.
expectedOutcomes.verification: Review each screenshot; exact frame indices and timestamps are outside this visual assertion.

cleanup: Harness sends Alt+F4 to the Kinovea window it launched; it never calls wineserver -k.
evidenceConfidence: Visual-only; human review is required, and screenshots do not establish exact timestamps or frame indices.
limitations: Default shortcut mappings were verified in source, but actual step outcome must be visually checked on this executable.
Screenshots do not prove exact timestamps or frame-selection semantics.
This visual trace does not establish exact timestamps or decoder frame indices.
